entry.author: New Zealand Trade and Enterprise
entry.summary:
Beachhead advisor Nicola O'Rourke has helped CPG and consumer goods business launch more than 200 products into major markets like the US, China and Australia. In this video, she explains how consumer goods exporters can identify and understand their target customers overseas by visiting the market, using online research and attending tradeshows.

Download market validation tools at my.NZTE. https://my.nzte.govt.nz/article/how-to-size-and-segment-your-target-market
